purpose: Describe epistemic dependency and warrant conservation independently of skills, agents, tools, artifacts, and temporal execution.

source_adaptation.basis: ERFL 0.2 Markdown corpus supplied for framework integration
source_adaptation.policy: Preserve its relational-coherence core while refining model construction, probing, refutation, support operations, and Mathformer output semantics.
source_adaptation.not_imported: Foreign workflow identifiers and gap-bearing projections are examples from another operational catalog and are not Mathformer contracts.

surface_syntax.policy: Use the supplied all-reasoning-flows syntax: reasoning blocks contain steps, a trailing ellipsis continues the same logical expression without adding semantics, and generated maps collapse programs without inventing handoffs.

M.rule: M constructs the explicit model; P executes or probes it.

R.rule: P produces bounded search or execution evidence; R forms the criterion-scoped assessment or refutational verdict.

mathformer_operation_extensions.O: Makes source observation explicit instead of collapsing intake into a gap or adjacent inference.
mathformer_operation_extensions.Q: Makes retrieval explicit and preserves its candidate-only authority ceiling.
mathformer_operation_extensions.G: Makes grounding and applicability checking explicit after retrieval.
mathformer_operation_extensions.F: Makes constructive formalization explicit before execution or verification.
mathformer_operation_extensions.P: Separates execution, probing, and falsification search from model construction and verdict formation.
mathformer_operation_extensions.X: Makes diagnosis and immutable revision identity explicit.

reference_alignment.port_adaptation: Reference semantic constructors are written as handle::Root<Subject>; Bundle is used for products, alternatives, and collections when member-level identities are retained.
reference_alignment.catalog_policy: The canonical all-flows catalogue contains semantic ERFL profiles and interpretations only. Skill, hook, action, and operational-loop mappings are generated separately.
reference_alignment.divergence_policy: Every extension must preserve the 0.2 relational-coherence core, document its authority ceiling and migration rule, and remain distinguishable from implementation scheduling or resource effects.

O.name: source observation
O.claim_ceiling: what the inspected source explicitly contains

S.name: structural decomposition
S.claim_ceiling: an explicit structure under the chosen decomposition

M.name: semantic model construction
M.claim_ceiling: an explicit model, not adequacy of the model

Q.name: retrieval
Q.claim_ceiling: candidate relevance or exact presence, not applicability

T.name: structural analogy and transfer
T.claim_ceiling: candidate transfer under an explicit correspondence

F.name: constructive formalization
F.claim_ceiling: candidate artifact with unresolved validation obligations

D.name: deductive entailment and valid transformation
D.claim_ceiling: entailed given recorded premises, rules, and checker scope

C.name: contrastive and counterfactual reasoning
C.claim_ceiling: contrast supported under the controlled difference

P.name: execution, probing, and falsification search
P.claim_ceiling: observed behavior or counterexample within the declared scope

R.name: critical assessment and refutational verdict
R.claim_ceiling: criterion-scoped assessment, refutation, or bounded nonrefutation

X.name: diagnosis and revision
X.claim_ceiling: diagnosis, repair proposal, or new revision identity

E.name: evidential calibration and epistemic governance
E.claim_ceiling: status or disposition only; no new substantive claim

erfl_0_2_migration.M: Expand model-based reasoning into M -probe> P so model construction and model execution remain distinct.
erfl_0_2_migration.R: Use P -test> R when a search or execution produces evidence; use R alone only when the assessment consumes already recorded evidence.

semantic_kinds.Claim: A proposition capable of truth or falsity.
semantic_kinds.Evidence: An inspectable item that bears on a claim only through a typed relation.
semantic_kinds.Model: An explicit formal, symbolic, numerical, semantic, or idealized representation.
semantic_kinds.Relation: A typed connection among immutable output identities.
semantic_kinds.Assessment: A criterion-scoped evaluation of an artifact, claim, or evidence set.
semantic_kinds.Decision: A calibration or operational disposition that creates no object-level evidence.
semantic_kinds.Obligation: A condition that remains open before a named use or promotion.
semantic_kinds.Plan: Prospective bounded reasoning or action with no authority until executed and assessed.
semantic_kinds.Presentation: A communicative projection with permanently inherited authority.
semantic_kinds.Bundle: A product, collection, alternative, context, or handoff whose members retain their authority.
semantic_kinds.Blocker: A current inability to continue, not falsity or impossibility.

interface_kinds.Context: An external or inherited input boundary.
interface_kinds.Scope: The domain, assumptions, claim ceiling, and applicability boundary.
interface_kinds.Delta: A genuine epistemic change; replay is not a delta.
interface_kinds.Unavailable: An operational inability, never negative scientific evidence.

observe.description: Inspect a source under declared provenance.

decompose.description: Expose units, dependencies, binders, or structure.

model.description: Construct an explicit semantic or formal model.

ground.description: Establish a scope-bound alignment or applicability relation.

assume.description: Retain a candidate explicitly as a premise without validating it.

generalize.description: Form a scoped provisional generalization from cases.

transfer.description: Transport structure through an explicit correspondence.

construct.description: Materialize a candidate formal or executable artifact.

derive.description: Derive a conditional consequence under declared rules and premises.

compare.description: Relate a baseline and alternative or compare trajectories.

probe.description: Examine a claim or model by execution, sampling, or controlled contrast.

test.description: Make a claim or artifact the object of falsification or critical assessment.

assess.description: Evaluate cited evidence against named criteria.

calibrate.description: Update status without creating a new substantive claim.

constrain.description: Use scope, status, or defeaters to narrow admissible outputs.

revise.description: Start a new diagnosis, hypothesis, model, transfer, artifact, or derivation identity.

preserve.description: Conserve operation type and epistemic interface explicitly.

resource_plane.semantics: Resource edges declare consumption or guarded external effects. They never sequence reasoning, conserve epistemic handles, or contribute warrant.
resource_plane.runtime_requirement: Actual access and persistence require versioned receipts; persistence must preserve content authority and history.

layout.whitespace_semantics: Each top-level statement begins on a new physical line. Within a logical goal, steps, repeat, or on statement, line breaks and indentation are non-semantic inter-token whitespace. Explicit delimiters, relations, branch operators, ports, predicates, resource arrows, and trailing continuation markers determine structure.
layout.preferred_chain_style: Put steps on its own line, end each continued chain segment with its relation and ..., then place the next occurrence on a separate indented line.
layout.preferred_group_style: Indent explicit parenthesized branches and prefix subsequent branches with & or |.
layout.preferred_interface_style: For long occurrence interfaces, break after TYPE[, list ports on indented lines, and place -> output on its own line.
layout.preferred_repeat_style: Open the bounded body with repeat min..max [, use relation-led continuation lines, and close with ] until predicate measure id.

invariants: Every transition uses a named relation and conserves at least one handle.
The goal handle is produced by the terminal calibration occurrence.
Every steps expression and repeat body terminates in E.
Accept and workflow-switch handlers are guarded by an E occurrence.
Iteration is bounded and names an observable progress measure.
Alternative branches expose the same output-handle and port-kind interface; every required parallel branch contributes a conserved handle at its join.
A gap occurrence _ is preserved as unknown and makes the profile non-executable.
Not-refuted-within-scope is not proof, and calibration creates no substantive claim.
Resource arrows contribute no epistemic warrant, and persistence is authorized only by E.
Validation establishes projection coherence, not execution, projection completeness, resource availability, persistence success, or truth.
